text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything on its own. Mixed and single-sex panels occur routinely by chance and by who happens to be available at that grade; in many ministries women are now a majority of senior HR and policy staff. Panel composition tells you nothing about how the candidates were scored.

Raising it would likely be read as sour grapes and could damage your standing internally — a real cost for a ten-year civil servant.

The genuine issue is the unanswered request. Chase it formally, in writing, citing your right to feedback and any internal deadline. Ask for the scoring matrix and panel notes. If the written reasons then look thin or inconsistent, escalate on *that* basis.
